content.name: Extended Communication Ranges (NoNukes Version)
content.description:
# Extended Communication Ranges - ExComm (Nexus Version) This mod aim to add a way to engage a conversation with NPC outside the regular comm range by adding a Long Range Comm Beam to your ship. This alternative version of the mod to not need SirNukes API to work.
To use Long Range Comm Beam: - Select a target (ship or station) - Open Long Range Scan (default key: 'L') - A menu will open to ask you if you want to use the regular Long Range Scan or redirect power to the Long Range Comm Beam (ExComm LRCB by-pass).
